subject: Lumina POC: Access provisioning, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Lumina POC: Access provisioning, success criteria & next steps

Hi Katie —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and agreed next steps from today's call so we have alignment going into the POC: 

1) Success criteria (what Lumina will use to evaluate):
- End-to-end latency at our typical payload: 95th percentile under 350ms for 8k token average.
- Per-request semantic accuracy on 200 test prompts: >= 88% pass rate as measured by your QA rubric.
- Stable throughput: sustained 60 concurrent requests without increased error rate.

2) Scope & evaluation plan:
- Week 1 (Feb 24–Mar 1): Provision access and ingest 3 sample datasets.
- Week 2 (Mar 2–Mar 8): Execute eval prompts and collect latency/cost metrics.
- Week 3 (Mar 9–Mar 15): Iteration with quantization/parameter tuning and run final validation.

3) Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead) + Dev (technical provisioning/SSO/API keys).
- Lumina: Katie (POC owner) + Lumina IT (network/IP allowlist and SSO admin).

4) Access we'll provide this week:
- SSO invite to your Okta tenant (SP-initiated SAML).
- One-time API key scoped to POC usage (rotated after POC).
- IP allowlist entries for your egress NAT ranges.

Attachments: I've attached the success criteria spreadsheet and our POC setup guide.

Action items I'll own: send SSO/SP metadata to your IT, provision API key and IP allowlist entries once IT confirms ranges, and share a HubSpot POC checklist.

If that looks right we'll target provisioning on Wednesday (Feb 24).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
